# Wellows

> Wellows (wellows.com) is an AI visibility platform for brands and agencies. It tracks how ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Google AI Mode cite and describe a brand against its competitors, and turns the gaps it finds into content and outreach work.

Wellows.com is an AI visibility platform. Wellows helps brands track their visibility in five AI search engines: ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Perplexity, and Gemini. Wellows.com is not wellows.ai. Wellows.com does not sell compression socks and is not a digital wellness brand. Wellows is a Disrupt.com company, and its founder and CEO is Masab Gadit.

Wellows works in the AI search layer. It is not a keyword rank tracker or a backlink database, and it does not guarantee citations or rankings. It does not currently track Claude or Microsoft Copilot. Older descriptions of Wellows as an AI SEO agent or an "autonomous marketer" reflect its earlier positioning. KIVA is the name of Wellows' built-in writing agent, not a separate company.

In Wellows, visibility means citations. The AI Visibility Score, also called the Brand Visibility Score, is a brand's citations as a share of all citations across its tracked prompts and competitor set. Brand mentions inside answer text are tracked separately. Wellows counts two kinds of citation. An explicit citation is when an AI answer cites the brand's own page. An implicit citation is when an AI answer cites a third-party page that talks about the brand. A third-party page that AI engines cite for a brand's prompts but that never mentions the brand is an implicit citation opportunity, and Wellows lists these for outreach. Wellows reads each cited page and labels it positive, neutral, or negative toward the brand.

How Wellows collects data: answers are collected from each engine's live interface, the way users see them, rather than from APIs alone. Prompts can be added by hand, uploaded as a file, or suggested from Google Search Console. …

metrics.h1: Ask AI about your category and a competitor comes back. Not you.

E1.justification: The page's subject — an AI-search citation/visibility product — is described in the opening lines, but within the first 150 words the brand itself is only nameable from the URL string rather than a plain-text name.
E1.quote: The Result Crafter for AI search Ask AI about your category and a competitor comes back. Not you. Find the answers you’re missing, then get cited in them. Book a demoStart Free Trial → app.wellows.com/overview

E2.justification: The publishing organisation is clearly identifiable as Wellows from repeated self-naming in the body text, but no legal entity name, corporate details or about-section text is present in the supplied content.
E2.quote: Most AI visibility scores tell you what happened. Wellows gives you the path forward.

E3.justification: The page states its class as an AI visibility optimization platform, though it leads with the coined, non-standard label "Result Crafter" rather than a plain category term up front.
E3.quote: Wellows’ proven framework for AI visibility optimization.

E4.justification: The page differentiates itself from adjacent tools generically ("most tools", "the usual visibility metric") but names no real comparators — the listed competitors are placeholder domains — and never distinguishes Wellows from similarly-named entities.
E4.quote: We check both the AI answer and the source pages behind it, the layer most tools never open.

results.summary: The h1 ("Ask AI about your category and a competitor comes back. Not you.") and title ("AI Visibility Platform for Brands & Agencies | Wellows") share no significant token.

metrics.definitional_sentence: Your Citation Score is the effect.

A1.justification: Most headings are declarative claims rather than questions, and the text immediately below does resolve them (e.g., the eight-components heading is followed by an enumerated explanation), but some sections answer only with fragmentary mock-UI text or slogans before substance appears.
A1.quote: Eight underlying dynamics shaping the score. Wellows isn’t a single score. It’s eight specific components running underneath it, every day. Here’s what each one actually does.

A2.justification: Several passages stand alone well as self-contained excerpts, but large stretches are interface fragments and one-line labels like "See Know exactly where you stand." that lose meaning once removed from the page layout.
A2.quote: The usual visibility metric just counts mentions – it drifts with every model update, a signal you can’t control. Citations are different: a real source the AI pulled from to build its answer. That’s the part of AI search you can actually work on.

A3.justification: Case-study claims carry concrete figures, timeframes and named platforms, but they sit alongside unverifiable vagueness such as "Know exactly what to fix" and dashboard numbers drawn from placeholder competitors like Aarbenth.com.
A3.quote: “In 45 days, grew citations from 6.5% to 24.3% on ChatGPT and Perplexity.” 6.5% → 24.3% Citation Score · 45 days

A4.justification: The vendor is plainly the speaker and testimonials carry full names plus roles, but the basis for the Citation Score figures and the "Trusted by 6,341+ brands" count is never explained or sourced.
A4.quote: Wellows changes this completely. Freddie ChattEcommerce SEO Consultant

notes.summary: No question-form headings on this page: C-6.4-d is NOT_APPLICABLE, and definitional extractability is assessed instead (E-6.4-7).
